name: Neck Transition
algorithm: Neck Transition — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes the face-neck transition zone for deepfake detection:

1. **TransitionZoneIdentification**: The boundary region between the face (jaw, chin) and neck is identified. This transition zone is typically 20-50 pixels wide and is the most common artifact location for face-swap deepfakes.

2. **기울기분석**: The image gradient across the transition zone is measured. Natural face-neck transitions show smooth, anatomically motivated gradients: skin color gradation, shadow from the mandible, and texture transition from facial skin to neck skin. Deepfake blending produces characteristic gradient anomalies — either over-smoothed (Poisson blending) or showing color steps.

3. **RenderingQualityDiscontinuity**: The effective resolution and detail level on either side of the transition is compared. Generated faces may have different rendering quality than the original neck — different noise patterns, different compression artifacts, or different texture granularity. These quality discontinuities at the transition indicate compositing.

4. **AnatomicalTransition검증**: The face-neck transition should follow anatomical constraints: submental contour, hyoid region, sternocleidomastoid muscle visibility. The method checks whether surface geometry at the transition is anatomically correct. Deepfake blending may produce anatomically implausible neck-face junctions.

5. **시간적Transition추적**: The transition zone characteristics are tracked across frames. Natural transitions remain anatomically consistent. Deepfake transitions may show varying artifact intensity — more visible at extreme head poses, during fast motion, or under challenging lighting — creating temporal variation in boundary quality.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through neck transition analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
